recognize_zh: 這不是型態學影像，而是間期細胞核的螢光原位雜交（interphase FISH）：藍色 DAPI 核內可見三個綠色、兩個水藍色與兩個紅色訊號；若依常見 CLL panel 綠色代表 CEP12，則為 trisomy 12，此異常與非典型型態 CLL 相關。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained blue with DAPI
Three green signals, suggesting a chromosomal gain of the corresponding locus
Two aqua and two red signals, consistent with normal copy number at those loci
Signals are discrete and well separated, allowing reliable enumeration in this nucleus
Probe identities are not labeled; interpretation assumes a standard CLL panel with green CEP12
describe_en: Interphase FISH image shows a single DAPI-counterstained nucleus with three green signals, two aqua signals, and two red signals. Assuming a standard CLL panel in which the green probe is the chromosome 12 centromere (CEP12) and the red/aqua probes target 13q14 (D13S319) and 13q34, the pattern indicates trisomy 12 without 13q14 deletion. A single nucleus cannot establish a clone, and the result must be based on scoring of an adequate number of nuclei against laboratory cutoffs. Trisomy 12 is associated with atypical CLL morphology (increased prolymphocytes and cleaved or plasmacytoid cells) and CD5+ cases with FMC7/CD22 or brighter surface light chain expression.
